questions.stem_text:
Of the following page-replacement policies, which is guaranteed to incur the minimum
number of page faults?

options.A: Replace the page whose next reference will be the longest time in the future.
options.B: Replace the page whose next reference will be the shortest time in the future.
options.C: Replace the page whose most recent reference was the shortest time in the past.
options.D: Replace the page whose most recent reference was the longest time in the past.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Replace the page whose next reference will be the longest time in the future.

ofservice (D D o S) attack differs from a denial-ofservice (D o S) attack?

options.B: The number of computers being attacked
options.C: The number of computers launching the attack
options.D: The time period in which the attack occurs

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - The number of computers launching the attack
